market.what: Li-selective DLE materials (sorbents, ion-exchange resins, extractants) bought by brine projects, world
market.method: avg of Mordor $162M (2025) and OG Analysis 12.4 kt x $29k/t = $360M (2026); reports differ ~2x

value.logic: DLE output ~250 kt LCE/yr by 2032 (62 kt 2025 at ~18%/yr) x ~$1,350/t: +5% Li recovery x $17k/t LCE ($850) + ~$500/t less Na polishing/IX opex (DLE opex $2.8-8.7k/t)
value.revenue_logic: ~5% of a ~$400M DLE-materials market (2031) via sorbent/extractant sales or license to a resin maker
value.margin_logic: specialty extractant/sorbent; resin makers (Sunresin) price ~$29k/t; licensed share lower cost

trend.drivers: EV/storage Li demand +146% 2024-30 (IEA); US Smackover and Salton Sea DLE builds; DLE capacity 62 kt to ~325 kt by 2035
trend.deadline: US Smackover DLE FIDs and first output 2026-2028 (SWA, Exxon)

competition.notes: Crowded. Lilac $352M raised (Series C Jun 2026, DOE $100M award); EnergyX $450M GEM commitment; Summit $25.5M 2025 ($96M total)

lab.synth: 1-2 step custom: s0 (2,4-dicumylphenol) is catalog; 2-3 variants by ortho/para substitution
lab.test: batch solvent extraction / sorption on synthetic Smackover-type brine (Na/Li >1000); Li, Na, K, Ca, Mg by ICP-OES; distribution ratios and Li/Na factor at a university hydromet lab
lab.logic: catalog 1 wk + custom 5 wk + tests 3 wk + formulation 1 wk; s0 ~$0.5k + 2 variants x $6k CRO + ~60 ICP-OES samples x $50 + lab time ~$9k

sale.gates: on-site pilot column/SX loop on real brine 6-12 mo (cycle life 1000+ cycles); developer DFS + FID; supply agreement with EPC/resin partner
